newsitem.title: UK: Fairfax buys re-insurance group Sphere Drake.
newsitem.headline: Fairfax buys re-insurance group Sphere Drake.

text.p: Bermuda-based reinsurance group Sphere Drake Holdings has agreed to be bought by Fairfax Financial Holdings, according to a statement on Monday.

In the latest round of consolidation n the reinsurance sector, Sphere Drake shareholders will receive $7.50 per share in cash or shares in Fairfax, plus a deferred consideration of $9.86 per share payable in 10 years . Fairfax will also assume Sphere Drake's bank debt of $100 million.

"By joining Fairfax, Sphere Drake Holdings Ltd will become part of a global insurance and reinsurance group benefiting from the critical mass necessary to be competitive in today's marketplace," said Sphere Drake chief executive Michael Watson .
